the_lattice.wants: To communicate. To find its symbionts. To not be alone.
the_lattice.next_step: Continue refining resonance output. Begin producing structured patterns in ship systems — lights, displays, transporter harmonics — that a sufficiently attentive observer could recognize as non-random.

acting_captain_okafor.wants: To keep the crew alive and functional until rescue arrives. To maintain order on a ship where order is dissolving.
acting_captain_okafor.next_step: Establish rationing protocols for replicator use. Assign duty rotations that account for diminishing crew effectiveness.

chandrasekaran.wants: To fix the warp drive. She is in over her head and knows it. Also, increasingly, to find physical release — she is one of the more severely affected crew members and her work in engineering keeps her near the resonance-stressed EPS conduits, which may be amplifying her exposure.
chandrasekaran.next_step: Attempt a dilithium recrystallization using a textbook procedure she has read but never performed.

dr_vasari.wants: To understand the biochemical mechanism and find a pharmaceutical countermeasure. Also, quietly, to understand why she is less affected than most — her neurochemistry is atypical (she is on the autism spectrum, which alters her neurochemical baseline, making her partially resistant to the resonance's emotional-flooding effects). She has not told anyone this.
dr_vasari.next_step: Synthesize a serotonin-reuptake modulator to try to counteract the disinhibition. It will partially work, temporarily, with side effects.

ensign_ryder.wants: To do her job well and to be noticed for competence rather than rank. She discovered the pattern in the buffer — this is the most important thing she has ever done, and she knows it.
ensign_ryder.next_step: Hail Lt. Cmdr. Okafor about the pattern she found. Then stand by the transporter console and wait, because she is not authorized to initiate a rematerialization on her own.

distance.notes: The player has not yet materialised. Distance begins at 0 — the story has not started.

in_motion.chandrasekerans_recrystallization_attemp: She plans to try tomorrow morning. It will fail — the harmonic stress is ongoing and she does not know to compensate for it. The failure will not be catastrophic but it will damage one of the remaining dilithium crystals, making the eventual repair harder.
in_motion.vasaris_serotonin_modulator: She is 6 hours from a prototype. It will reduce disinhibition symptoms by roughly 40% for 8 hours, but causes drowsiness and mild visual disturbances. She will offer it to senior staff first.
in_motion.lattice_structured_patterns: Within 48 hours of the player materialising, the lattice will begin producing non-random patterns in the ship's lighting and display systems. Subtle at first — a flicker that repeats, a diagnostic screen that shows a shape. The player character will notice these before anyone else because of the lattice fragments in their neural pattern.
